text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah, Admire Groove... Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...?
You're that person from the other day...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Yes, this is Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Are you having a meal now?
I see, so that's the kind of thing you eat...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You're even interested in the meal menu?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Oh dear, again...?)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Are you reading a book on sports medicine? Could that book possibly be—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It's a book I heard about at the New Year's party. I felt I needed it too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I read it on my teacher's recommendation, too!
I'd love to exchange thoughts on it sometime.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Sensei...
Ah, you mean Air Groove-san's mother.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...What is it, Trainer?
Is there something... on my face?
choice_data_list: I've been seeing you with Duramente a lot lately...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. We do bump into each other and chat quite a lot. But..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is all.
I am not doing anything out of the ordinary.
"Even if they met by chance, Admire Groove isn't the type to entertain someone for long."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, time to get to training.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Somehow... you're throwing me off my rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's take a little break.
Alright, let's take a quick breather.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Phew............
The power behind my push-off needs a little more—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Admire Grooveâsenpai.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was you. That running form...
I can recognize it from a mile away.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A form that converts every ounce of full-body power
into propulsion without waste.
You built that... at the end of tireless devotion.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me!
I have a special favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Would you... take a look at my running just once?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I want my running to reach that level as well.
Through the endless devotion that lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I... have never given
instruction to anyone before, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Please.

"An attitude of boundless humility.
Even so, Admire Groove
still seemed bewildered..."
choice_data_list: I'll watch over you, so why not give it a try together?
I'll watch, so why don't we try doing a little together?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
And so, together with Admire Groove, we decided to watch Duramente run, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: HAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...What incredible leg power...!?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...39 seconds...!
choice_data_list: 39 seconds for 600m on the slope... and she hasn't even debuted yet.

text_block_list.text: Not many Umamusume in the Junior Class show this kind of power. Even fewer before their debut.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
I'm heading out onto the turf track.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san.
...It's just tandem training, but... are you good to go?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
!
By all means...!
And—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Kh... oooooooooooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...She's keeping up so well...! Even though
her form is still unpolished...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (No doubt about it. This girl is... raw talent personified...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah...
Running alongside you made it crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Just how much rigorous training
backs your running...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Umâcould I ask for your help again sometime?
Whenever you have a moment is fine." his time?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I must do my best, too, so that I can
serve as a worthy opponent for you, even if just a little...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Fine.
You'll be making yourself useful to me as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
――!!
Thank you so much!
Admire Groove glanced at me for a split second, but answered without waiting for my reply.
Ever since then—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaah!!
Daaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Kh, lagging behind again...
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Your cornering is still too weak.
Running like that will throw your body off balance.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Which means... controlling initial speed
at the corner entry is the solution... right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, if you drop speed going into the corner,
your acceleration coming out of it will also lag. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You must hone the strength and flexibility to endure without dropping your initial speed.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I will devote myself to improving.
The conversation between Admire Groove and Duramente flowed smoothly.

A relationship of mutual understanding without needing words.
The seamless, resonant moments continued.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... very much.
Um, Alve-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Your guidance is, how should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Was there something that was hard to understand?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"It gives a sense of comfort.
Listening to it really touches the heart, or rather..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It feels... so natural.
I can feel my feet firmly planted on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (This... feeling. Again...?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I have no interest in others.
Or so it was supposed to be...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(An unfamiliar sensation is spreading through me...
This... fulfillment...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (At the very least, this time hasn't been meaningless.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: See you... tomorrow, then.
—A few days later. While in a meeting with Admire Groove...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're both here. Perfect timing.
There's something I need to discuss with you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ? Air Groove-san... and—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Today... I came because I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Alv-senpai. I want to... learn running from you more formally.
...I wish to become your apprentice.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Your running is very close
to what I am aiming for. What's more...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's different from Big Sis Groove and the others;
she has something truly unique of her own.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Now, with my participation in the Twinkle Series drawing near,
if I am to take on a new master, it can only be you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I'll make sure they don't get in the way.
I'm not asking you to set aside special time, either.
Would you let them learn by your side?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Trainer.
choice_data_list: If Alv's okay with it, I'm fine with it.
If you don't mind, Alv, then that's fine with me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Like I told you before, I'm not very good at teaching. Are you sure you're okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"It's not going well..."
I personally don't feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I look forward to working with you once again,
Alv-senpai.

From that point on, Admire Groove began watching
Duramente's training in earnest—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Please stop teasing me.
I'm not of such grand caliber."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: However... her talent is the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
She might one day become an Umamusume
who builds an entire era.
choice_data_list: It's a bit surprising to hear you praise someone so much.
It's surprising to hear you praise someone that much

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I am not praising you.
I am merely stating my impressions."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I consider it my duty... to inherit
what has been passed down and carry it forward.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I believe respect for the "strong"
is shown by learning from them and carrying on their legacy.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I want to... learn. I want to inherit it.
The strength of Sensei, of Big Sister Groove... and of you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (So... that's how you see things...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry for staying so long.
I'll be taking my leave now."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Every day has been beyond anything I ever imagined... But I don't find it unpleasant, not in the least. In fact...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Looking back... learning from Air Groove-san
is what truly changed me.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Then... just maybe... even for someone like me who's lived all alone...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—Will I be able to do it?
To leave something behind... for someone?)
